mapper.update: UPDATE order_delivery_task SET status = 'ASSIGNED', assignee_id = #{staff.id}, assignee_name = #{staff.nickname}, assignee_mobile = #{staff.phone}, assigned_by = #{operatorId}, assigned_by_name = #{operatorName}, attempt_no = attempt_no + 1, version = version + 1, picking_started_at = NULL, picked_up_at = NULL, exception_code = NULL, exception_summary = NULL, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = #{operateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND version = #{version} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT order_info.* FROM order_info AS order_info INNER JOIN order_delivery_task AS task ON task.tenant_id = order_info.tenant_id AND task.order_id = order_info.id AND task.del_flag = '0' WHERE order_info.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND order_info.delivery_way = '3' AND order_info.status = '3' AND order_info.pay_status = '1' AND task.status = 'DELIVERED' AND task.delivered_at < #{deadline} AND order_info.del_flag = '0'
